---
name: Proposal
about: Propose something the Union should build
title: "[Proposal] "
labels: proposal, stage:idea
---

## Summary
<!-- One or two sentences: what is it? -->

## Problem
<!-- What's broken, overpriced, missing, or user-hostile today? Who feels the pain? -->

## Proposed solution
<!-- What would we build? Why is it better than what exists? -->

## Target users / market
<!-- Who would pay or use it? How many of them? Who are the competitors? -->

## Revenue path
<!-- Required for product proposals. How does this make money, and roughly how soon? -->

## MVP scope
<!-- The smallest version worth shipping. Target: ≤ 3 months. -->

## Effort & skills
- Estimated effort: <!-- e.g., 4 people × 10 h/week × 12 weeks -->
- Skills needed: <!-- e.g., backend (Go), frontend (React), design, DevOps -->

## Risks
<!-- Technical, legal, market. What could kill this? -->

## Prospective Project Lead
<!-- Who will lead it if it's approved? -->

## Backers (need 5 to go to a vote)
<!-- Backers comment: "I back this. Commitment: <hours/week>. Skills: <...>" -->
